transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. What brings you in to see me?

I guess... they told me I needed to come in. We had a staff meeting at work and... I got a little worked up. 

I started acting out this whole fall-prevention drill. Just moving chairs around, waving my arms... Folks kept telling me to sit down, but I don't know, I just couldn't seem to stop. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Before this happened, had you used any drugs, alcohol, or stimulant-type substances—like cocaine, amphetamines, or energy supplements—in the days leading up to that meeting?
No. I don't use any of that. Just... regular stuff. No drugs or anything.
How many days in a row have you been feeling this unusually energetic, elevated, or 'keyed up' before today?
I don't really know. I don't... I don't keep track of stuff like that. Maybe a few days, I guess. Hard to say.

During this time, have you experienced anything like hearing voices, seeing things others don't see, or having beliefs—like feeling you have special powers or a special mission—that others found unusual or untrue?

I don't... I don't really have special powers or anything like that. 

But... I guess sometimes, when I'm working... or just at home near the laundry room, I hear things. Like... my name. Or one of the residents yelling for help. It sounds real. Clear as day. But... when I go look, nobody's there. So... I don't know.
During these past few days, have you needed much less sleep than usual but still felt full of energy the next day?

I guess so. I mean... I haven't been sleeping much. Maybe two, three hours a night. But I wake up before the sun's even out and... I don't know, I just feel ready to go. I'll just be up, doing stuff, making plans while it's still dark out. It doesn't really feel like anything's wrong with it.
Do you ever hear these voices or sounds at times when you're not feeling this energetic or 'keyed up'—like when your mood and energy are more normal?

Yeah... I guess so. There was a stretch where I was... calmer. Sleeping more regular, not rushing around with all those projects. But... for a few weeks around then, I still kept hearing my name. And... I don't know, I just felt sure people at work were keeping notes on me. So... yeah.
During that calmer stretch when your sleep and energy were back to normal, about how many weeks did you continue hearing your name or feeling like people were watching you?
I don't know... maybe two or three weeks? It was just... a few weeks where I wasn't doing all those projects, but I still heard it. And I still knew they were taking notes. That's all.
Thinking back to when all of this first started—hearing your name, feeling watched, and the periods of high energy—about how many weeks or months in total has all of this been going on?

I guess... maybe a year and a half? Around a year and five months, I think. It started back when... well, we got a new supervisor at work. He started criticizing what I was doing. Took away some of the briefings I used to handle. So... yeah, since around then.
